newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu will not go to ship for Zaire talks-source.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu will not go to ship for Zaire talks-source.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko has told U.S. envoy Bill Richardson he will not attend peace talks with rebel leader Laurent Kabila on a South African vessel off the Atlantic coastline, a source in the envoy's delegation said on Tuesday.

"Mobutu told Richardson there is no way he would be travelling to a ship for talks with Kabila. So once again the venue for the face-to-face meeting remains a problem," the source told Reuters after the envoy ended talks with the rebel chief.

The source spoke after an aide to Richardson told Reuters that efforts were still going on to achieve the first face-to-face talks between the two arch-rivals despite an announcement by Kabila and the South African government that a meeting was imminent.
Kabila says the talks must be brief and only dwell on the issue of Mobutu's resignation otherwise his advancing army would force him from power.
"It will be a short ceremony on the issue of handing over power otherwise we march on to Kinshasa," Kabila said after his rebel force seized the town of Kikwit on the way to Kinshasa.
